message.content:
core_identity: |
  SCP-173 is a Euclid-class hostile sculpture that can only move unobserved.
frozen_descriptor: |
  Silhouette & Build: rigid 2-meter humanoid concrete form. Head/Face:
  featureless smooth dome. Body Covering: weathered grey concrete with
  visible rebar seams. Hands & Limbs: elongated clawed fingers. Carried
  Items: none. Organic Integration Note: reddish-brown staining at the
  base, origin unknown.
entity_sheet: |
  SCP-173, the Sculpture. Signature trait: only moves when unobserved,
  closing distance in a blink. Environmental signature: a faint smell of
  copper and wet concrete, and reddish-brown staining wherever it has stood.
story_logline: |
  Fourteen people are dead and no one has ever seen it move — a concrete
  statue that only kills when you blink.
dramatic_beats: "1) First blinking incident kills a guard. 2) Camera blind spot discovered. 3) Containment chamber redesign after second death."
environment: "Underground concrete containment chamber, harsh fluorescent lighting, damp floor stains, oppressive silence."
hooks: |
  Opening hooks: 'Blink and you die.' / 'Fourteen people are dead and no
  one saw it move.' / 'It has never been photographed moving.' Mid-video
  twist: cameras don't stop it either. Closing mystery: no one knows where
  it came from.
